title: Partition Labels
statement: Partition `s` into as many parts as possible so each letter appears in at most one part. Return a list of the part sizes, in order.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters
hints: Record the last index of every character.
Extend the current part's end to the last index of every character you see inside it.
When the scan index reaches that end, the part is closed. Record its length and start a new one.

approaches.name: Re-scan for each cut
approaches.explanation: Find the farthest last occurrence repeatedly.

editorial: A part that contains a character must extend at least through that character's last occurrence. Taking the max last-index inside the current window is the earliest legal cut. Cutting there is safe and maximal, so the greedy cuts produce the required partition.

examples.explanation: The whole string is one part.
